description: This file implements a text formatter for logging, including functions for cloning, formatting log entries, context, metrics, and hex dumps, as well as handling errors and metadata formatting within a logging framework.

classes.name: text_formatter
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting log entries into text, supporting various formatting options including context, metrics, and hex dumps.

classes.name: contextual_text_formatter
classes.description: A subclass of text_formatter that adds contextual metadata formatting for logs.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the formatter object.

methods.name: format_full_queue_error
methods.description: Formats a message indicating potential skipped log lines.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log entry with metadata into the buffer.

methods.name: format_context_begin
methods.description: Begins a context dump in the log.

methods.name: format_context_end
methods.description: Ends a context dump in the log.

methods.name: format_metric_set_begin
methods.description: Begins a set of metrics in the log.

methods.name: format_metric_set_end
methods.description: Ends a set of metrics in the log.

methods.name: format_list_begin
methods.description: Begins a list in the log.

methods.name: format_metadata
methods.description: Formats log metadata such as timestamp, log name, tag, context, and label.
